description: Norovirus dose_adjustment refit on the CORRECTED model: the VSP trigger now fires on cumulative reported passenger cases (PR #325) and recovery is measured from symptom onset rather than from exposure, so the infectious course is incubation + recovery_day. Both changes invalidate the c1_single_dose_hours_v1 answer (a common dose of 12.25-12.5): that fit was scored as infections/complement against a model whose response never engaged and whose symptomatic window was recovery_day minus incubation (~1.8 d for norwalk_gi instead of 3 d). This campaign re-answers the same question - can ONE dose_adjustment sit inside all four class-binned CDC VSP IQRs at once - on the endpoint VSP actually records: cumulative reported (sick-called) PASSENGER cases divided by the passenger complement, in the syndromic branch. dose_adjustment is a log10 shedding penalty subtracted from the shedding curve in engines/infection_dynamics_bridge.py, so higher values mean LESS transmission. The window moves UP from 11.5-13.0 to 12.0-14.0 for two measured reasons that push in opposite directions and net upward: (1) the onset-clock fix raised the conditional attack rate by 1.9 pp and symptomatic person-epochs by 29% in a 10-seed expedition takeoff cell, so a given dose now transmits more and needs a larger penalty; (2) the reported-case numerator is only 87-93% of passenger ever-ill in those same takeoff runs (95/102, 103/116, 105/114, ...), so the reported endpoint sits just below the infection endpoint rather than orders of magnitude below - the earlier expectation that a case endpoint would force a much LOWER dose came from the pre-fix numerator, which double-counted quarantine refusers and background noise. 0.25 steps because a 1.0-step grid could not resolve the common value last time. Only n_init=1: the fit is scored on the single-introduction cell, and n_init=5 overshot every class IQR at every dose in this band. 40 seeds per cell because the separating endpoint is takeoff probability (~0.5-0.7 here), so both the marginal median and the conditional-on-takeoff median must be resolved; outcomes are bimodal (fizzle at the index case, or 18-40% attack rate) and a single median hides that. Seeds 760-799 are disjoint from the local pilot (500-519), clock_arm_c1_refit_v1 (700-719) and c1_single_dose_hours_v1 (720-759), so all four sets pool as independent draws. syndromic is the branch the fit is scored on, because a VSP record is a rate reported after an adaptive response has already acted; none_true runs on the identical cells as the counterfactual half of the argument - if a single dose fits all four classes WITH the medical response and no single dose fits them without it, the class-size pattern in the VSP data is produced by the response rather than by transmission alone. The legacy_epoch_day clock is retired and is not run here; its numbers are not a reference.
